title: Facebook post_impressions and post reach metrics no longer return data
symptoms: post_impressions, post_impressions_unique, post_views and post_engaged_users return errors or nothing
post_video_views, post_clicks and post_reactions_by_type_total still answer
cause: Meta deprecated post-level impressions, unique impressions, views and engaged users for Facebook Page posts on 2026-06-16. It is a platform change, not a token or permission problem.
fix: Drop those metrics. Use the ones that still answer, and use Instagram insights for reach.
affected: Graph API, Facebook Page posts, from 2026-06-16
